tasks.title: Fix: No .env file committed to the repo
tasks.why: Anyone with repo access (or a leak) gets your real keys and can run up your bills or read your data.

tasks.title: Fix: No secrets hard-coded in source
tasks.why: Keys in code end up in git history and, for frontend code, in every visitor's browser.

tasks.title: Fix: Every API route that changes or reveals user data checks who is calling
tasks.why: An unprotected route lets anyone on the internet read or edit other users' data.

tasks.title: Fix: Database access rules (row-level security) are enabled
tasks.why: With Supabase/Firebase, the browser talks to the database directly: no rules means anyone can read everything.

tasks.title: Fix: Payment webhooks verify the signature
tasks.why: Without it anyone can POST a fake 'payment succeeded' and get your product free.

tasks.title: Fix: Privacy policy page exists
tasks.why: Required in most places once you collect emails or use analytics; payment/ad providers require it.

plan.label: Day 1
exit_criteria: Re-run /launch-gaps and /launch-verdict; score has not dropped

tasks.title: Verify: Paid features are enforced on the server, not only hidden in the UI
tasks.why: Hiding a button is not access control: free users can call the API directly.

tasks.title: Verify: Live-mode keys and webhook secret configured for production (not test keys)
tasks.why: Test keys in production mean you take no real money; live keys in dev risk real charges.

tasks.title: Verify: Automatic database backups are on and a restore was tried
tasks.why: One bad migration or deleted table can end the business without a backup you've actually restored.

tasks.title: Fix: Refund and cancellation terms
tasks.why: Buyers who can't find the refund rules turn into chargebacks.

tasks.title: Fix: A way for users to reach you
tasks.why: Paying customers need a working support address and an owner who reads it.

tasks.title: Fix: Terms of service page exists
tasks.why: Sets the rules for use, refunds and liability; expected by payment providers.

tasks.title: Fix: .gitignore excludes .env files
tasks.why: Without it, the next `git add .` commits your secrets.

tasks.title: Fix: Rate limiting on login, signup and expensive routes
tasks.why: Bots can brute-force passwords, spam you, or burn paid API credits within hours of launch.

tasks.title: Fix: Security headers set (CSP/HSTS/X-Frame-Options etc.)
tasks.why: Cheap protection against clickjacking, MIME sniffing and some XSS.

plan.label: Day 2
exit_criteria: Re-run /launch-gaps and /launch-verdict; score has not dropped

tasks.title: Fix: User input is validated on the server
tasks.why: Without validation, malformed or hostile input reaches your database and crashes things.

tasks.title: Verify: Dependencies have no known critical vulnerabilities
tasks.why: Old packages are the most common way small apps get hacked.

tasks.title: Fix: Server-only keys are not exposed to the browser
tasks.why: Variables prefixed NEXT_PUBLIC_/VITE_/REACT_APP_ are shipped to every visitor.

tasks.title: Verify: Webhook handling is idempotent (same event twice = one effect)
tasks.why: Payment providers retry; duplicates can double-grant credits or double-send emails.

tasks.title: Verify: Failed payment and cancellation paths exist
tasks.why: Cards fail and customers cancel every week. Without handling, access and billing drift apart.

tasks.title: Fix: Refund/cancellation policy is stated (if charging money)
tasks.why: Disputes and chargebacks follow when buyers can't find the rules.

plan.goal: Raise the score; nothing here blocks launch.
plan.label: Day 3
exit_criteria: Re-run /launch-gaps and /launch-verdict; score has not dropped

tasks.title: Fix: Users can delete their account/data
tasks.why: Privacy laws (GDPR/CCPA) expect it, and users ask within weeks.

tasks.title: Fix: Named first channel
tasks.why: Name the one place the first 20 users come from.

tasks.title: Fix: Errors are reported to a tracker (Sentry or similar)
tasks.why: Without it you learn about crashes from angry users, if at all.

tasks.title: Fix: A health-check endpoint exists
tasks.why: Uptime monitors and hosts need one URL that says 'I'm alive'.

tasks.title: Fix: Automated tests exist for the critical paths
tasks.why: Without tests, every AI edit after launch can silently break signup or payment.

tasks.title: Fix: A CI pipeline runs build/tests on every push
tasks.why: Catches broken builds before users do.

tasks.title: Fix: A dependency lockfile is committed
tasks.why: Without it, production can install different versions than you tested.

tasks.title: Verify: Outbound calls (APIs, AI, email) have timeouts and failure handling
tasks.why: One slow third party can hang every request or crash the server.

tasks.title: Fix: Pages have a title, description and social preview tags
tasks.why: This is what Google and link previews show; blank means nobody clicks.

tasks.title: Fix: Friendly 404 and error pages
tasks.why: A raw stack trace or blank page at launch looks broken and leaks details.

plan.goal: Raise the score; nothing here blocks launch.
plan.label: Day 4
exit_criteria: Re-run /launch-gaps and /launch-verdict; score has not dropped

tasks.title: Domain, HTTPS and www/bare redirect work on the production host
Production environment variables set in the host; no test keys in production
Payments in live mode: live webhook and secret, one real purchase and refund
Email domain verified (SPF, DKIM, DMARC); receipt and reset email reach an inbox
Error tracking receives a test error; uptime check alerts a channel you read
Spend caps and budget alerts on every paid API and the cloud account

plan.goal: Everything outside the code that must be true on launch day.
plan.label: Day 5
exit_criteria: Every check passes on the production host, not on your laptop

tasks.title: Code freeze: only fixes for problems the rehearsal finds
Restore last night's backup into a scratch database and open the app
tasks.why: A backup you have never restored is a hope, not a backup.

tasks.title: Rollback drill: deploy a harmless change, then roll back to the previous deploy
Run the 10-minute smoke test end to end on a phone
Have 3 to 5 people sign up cold; watch where they stall, do not help
Write the announcement post and the first support-reply templates

plan.goal: Break it on purpose while it is still safe.
plan.label: Day 6
exit_criteria: Backup restored, rollback worked, a stranger finished signup

tasks.title: Go / no-go gate: blockers cleared, backup restored, someone else signed up
Deploy to production (you press the button; nothing here deploys for you)
Run the 10-minute smoke test on production and write down the time
Announce to the first small group, then widen (private beta, waitlist, public)
Watch errors, signups and payments for the first hour; answer every message
Write down day-one numbers and the three things you would change first

plan.goal: Ship it, watch it, learn from it.
plan.label: Launch Day
exit_criteria: You can see errors and signups as they happen

deferred.title: Verify: Password reset and email verification work (or a managed provider handles them)
deferred.why: Users who forget a password become support tickets or lost customers; unverified emails enable abuse.

deferred.title: Verify: Sending domain has SPF, DKIM and DMARC
deferred.why: Otherwise your signup and receipt emails land in spam.

deferred.title: Verify: You can roll back a bad deploy
deferred.why: The first bad release will happen; you need a way back in minutes.

deferred.title: Fix: Put a demo above the fold
deferred.why: A 20-second demo lifts sign-ups more than any copy change.

deferred.title: Fix: robots.txt and sitemap exist
deferred.why: Helps search engines find and index the right pages.

deferred.title: Fix: Images have alt text
deferred.why: Screen-reader users and SEO both rely on it.

deferred.title: Fix: An .env.example documents required variables
deferred.why: The next person (or you in 3 months) can't deploy without guessing.

deferred.title: Fix: README explains how to run and deploy
deferred.why: Future you and any helper need it.

after_launch.title: Read every error and support message; fix what blocks a new user
Review funnel: signup to first value to payment; pick one thing to improve
Re-run /launch, compare the score, plan the next month
